- **Fresh installation.** Start Frameleaf Library 1.2.3 with a new database. This version establishes the baseline for future upgrades. Databases from earlier test versions cannot be upgraded to 1.2.3.
- **Library imports.** More photo-library imports preserve ownership, ratings, albums and metadata. Unrated photos stay unrated.
- **Desktop wallet.** Frameleaf Desktop can read whether automatic AI credit top-up is enabled when it connects to a linked Library.
